scope.purpose: Evaluate whether shortlisted source samples map to NT-compatible catalog classes and the ParquetDataCatalog input path.

current_bte_manifest_exposure.reason: run_manifest.rs maps TradeTick, OrderBookDelta, Bar, QuoteTick, IndexPriceUpdate, MarkPriceUpdate, InstrumentStatus, and InstrumentClose into NautilusDataType, supports configured instrument_ids and multiple [[catalog_inputs]], and rejects unmapped data_type strings. Fidelity matching accepts TradeTick for TRADE_REPLAY, requires OrderBookDelta for L2_REPLAY while allowing supplemental TradeTick/status/close streams, and requires Bar for TRADE_BAR_REPLAY while allowing supplemental TradeTick/status/close streams. OrderBookDepth10 remains rejected until a typed manifest/catalog proof exists.

source_sample_mapping_status.decision: NT catalog/backtest input path is proven for this data family: accepted source proof to canonical trades to NT TradeTick catalog projection to query_typed_data read-back.

dependency_wiring_status.decision: BTE can claim bounded one-off NT Polymarket parser/provider reuse for the selected PMXT sample only. The committed canonical PMXT readiness gate keeps this one-off evidence separate from accepted broad source bindings, and broad backfill remains blocked until expanded coverage, throughput, dynamic tick-size replay, and reusable source acceptance are proven.

source_sample_mapping_status.decision: Do not build a custom BinaryOption instrument mapper. The selected PMXT sample has bounded one-off NT parser/provider, OrderBookDelta, TradeTick, ParquetDataCatalog read-back, BacktestNode, and result-contract evidence. The canonical PMXT readiness gate is committed and blocked, so this one-off evidence cannot be reused as canonical broad source acceptance. Do not start broad PMXT backfill until reusable coverage, throughput, dynamic tick-size replay, and acceptance proof are committed.

Official Kalshi historical data may support lower-fidelity Bar projection. BTE now admits Bar as the primary TradeBarReplay input, and the binary-option Bar ParquetDataCatalog projection/read-back path is source-fenced by the staged catalog proof. This does not select Kalshi or accept its pending source proof: raw Kalshi candlestick normalization, source acceptance, license/coverage/completeness/cost checks, and any historical L2 claim remain pending.

Treat as a higher-fidelity Kalshi candidate discovered by BTE-025, not as selected input. The bounded sample proves orderbook_snapshot/orderbook_delta schema, but it has no trades, no accepted BinaryOption instrument mapping, null source timestamps on snapshot rows, and no NT catalog read-back.
Keep as metadata-only/current-only. It cannot become NT replay catalog input until source-backed checked BinaryOption fields and accepted historical outcome replay coverage exist.

non_hardcoding_rules_for_the_next_mappin: Add NT data-class support by table family and source schema contract, not by venue name.
Keep concrete source bindings in TOML/proof artifacts and keep runtime mapping selected through source proof, not code constants.
Reuse NT instrument providers/parsers where NT already owns a venue instrument model.
Only build Bolt-owned adapters for raw-source-to-NT-typed data projection when NT does not already provide that raw-source parser.
Each new data class must have ParquetDataCatalog write and query_typed_data read-back proof before BacktestNode input is accepted.

task_conclusion.reason: BTE-022 is proven for the TradeTick perps/spot native-trades path, for one bounded PMXT Polymarket OrderBookDelta/TradeTick selected-source artifact, and for a staged binary-option Bar ParquetDataCatalog projection/read-back path. The canonical PMXT readiness gate is committed and remains blocked, keeping one-off PMXT evidence separate from accepted broad source bindings. Broad binary-option L2 paths and source selection remain pending until reusable coverage, source acceptance, dynamic tick-size replay, and raw-source normalization evidence are committed.
